rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for achieving an aim or goal.

example.english: I finally achieved success in this exam.
example.traditional: 呢次考試我終於成功喇。
example.jyutping: ni1 ci3 haau2 si3 ngo5 zung1 jyu1 sing4 gung1 laa3

rows.note: Use this specifically for financial profitability or a business making a profit.

example.english: The company saw financial success last quarter.
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 soeng6 gwai3 jing4 lei6 zang1 gaa1 zo2

rows.note: Use this noun phrase before a person or thing regarded as successful.

example.english: They are a singer who has achieved success.
example.jyutping: keoi5 hai6 jat1 go3 sing4 gung1 ge3 go1 sau2
